sources.lineageNote: EDGAR-distributed Texas Instruments Form 10-Q content republished by Public; materially different origin class from existing issuer newsroom evidence.

facts.claim: Q2 2026 revenue was $5.46B, up 23% year over year, with broad growth led by industrial, data center and automotive demand.
First-half 2026 revenue was $10.29B, up 21%; Analog revenue was $8.289B, up 24%, and Analog operating profit rose 43%.
Trailing-12-month cash flow from operations was $8.667B and reported non-GAAP free cash flow was $6.534B; first-half 2026 capital expenditures were $1.19B versus $2.43B a year earlier.

TXN expects $2B-$3B of 2026 capital expenditures and states post-2026 capex will depend on revenue and growth expectations; it reports $630M of up-to-$1.6B CHIPS direct funding received for three large-scale 300mm fabs in Sherman and Lehi.

The filing states owned manufacturing creates meaningful fixed-cost sensitivity: lower factory loadings reduce margins while higher loadings improve them, making utilization a material execution variable.

risks.risk: Owned manufacturing creates operating leverage in both directions; a demand relapse can reduce factory loadings and compress margins while capacity expansion costs remain.

unknowns.unknown: Current peer-relative valuation and a quantified incremental return on each new 300mm fab remain outside this Scout evidence and belong to Alpha underwriting.
